title: WebGL Ripple Click
desc: Up to five click origins travel into a fragment shader as uniform arrays. Expanding signed wavefronts displace a procedural mineral texture, overlap additively, fade by age, and release the render loop when finished.
hint: Each click drops a ripple; up to five overlap
sourceName: Seen on: image reveals, immersive landing pages, album artwork, and interactive campaign canvases
